name: Aldren Everyday Chino Short
description: Mid-thigh chino shorts in a synth-cotton twill with a flat front and two back welt pockets. Clean construction, slightly structured — not beach shorts, not work shorts, just shorts. The kind of thing you wear when it's warm and you want to look like you made an effort. Comes in khaki, navy, and stone.
what_it_says: You're casual but not sloppy. You probably have plans later that don't require you to change.
story_hooks: The back welt pocket is just barely large enough for a folded transit pass or a single printed photograph.
Someone is wearing these in a neighborhood where shorts signal you're not expecting trouble — which is itself information.

physical_description.visual_profile: A clean, composed silhouette that bridges casual and intentional—mid-thigh cut shorts that sit at a professional-casual baseline. The flat front and structured twill give them presence without aggression. Reads as someone who hasn't abandoned grooming standards, even in the heat.
physical_description.fit: Straight-leg, slightly tapered at the thigh with a relaxed break at the knee. Not slim, not baggy—proportioned to work with both augmented and baseline leg geometry. Waistband sits naturally at the hip.
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-cotton twill—a blended weave that breathes like natural cotton but resists staining and holds structure through thermal cycling common in GLMZ humidity.
physical_description.texture: Crisp diagonal twill weave with a subtle matte finish. Fabric maintains body and definition without stiffness. Seams are clean and double-stitched for durability.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in three neutral grounds: warm khaki (worn-sand tone), navy (deep but not black), and stone (cool greige). All render agnostic to skin tone and augmentation chrome.
physical_description.closures: Button fly with an internal friction-fit waistband adjuster. Metal button stamped with subtle Aldren mark—not ostentatious.
distinctive_features: Flat front construction—no pleats, no synthetic ruching
Two rear welt pockets (structural, not decorative)
Reinforced stress points at seams and closures
Hidden interior pocket on right side—phone-depth, RFID-shielded mesh
Graduated hem with minimal visible stitching
Neutral fiber content tag (no brand flash at waistband)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 boundary. Aldren positions this as accessible quality—not corpo haute couture, not street salvage. The manufacturing precision and material blend signal someone who can afford consistency but doesn't need to broadcast wealth.
physical_description.cultural_context: Office workers on rotating shift schedules, mid-level service sector, people who move between climate-controlled and open-air spaces. Worn by those who maintain presentation codes without rigidity—the uniform of functional professionals in the GLMZ who haven't defected to full tactical wear.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in after 3-4 wears; twill softens gradually. Minor fading at stress points (inner thigh, hip curve) develops over months. No visible wear damage in typical use—these shorts are built to age quietly.
